title: trailboss --json task ls
description: Every task, oldest first. state: to do (no agent in it and no commits), working, needs you (waiting on you, or at rest with no commits), reviewing (ready but for its review: no reviewer yet, one working, no notes written, or notes for an older commit of its branch; only when its review is on), ready (its agent at rest or ended, with commits on its branch, and reviewed when its review is on), done (accepted or removed), or missing (its worktree is gone). Frontends should show a state they don't know as is.

state.description: to do, working, needs you, reviewing, ready, done or missing; more may be added.

detail.description: Why: the agent's status or what it waits on, or how it ended.

commits.description: Commits on its branch that the base branch doesn't have; null once done.

files.description: Files its branch changed; null once done.

uncommitted.description: Changed paths not committed in its worktree; null once done or gone.

where.description: Where its agent runs now, as `live` says; null when none is.

session.description: AGENT:ID of its agent's session, while running.

review.description: Whether a second agent reviews its work before it's ready: `task add --review`, or the config's `tasks.review`; `task review` turns it on.

notes.description: The file its latest reviewer wrote its notes to, once written; null before.
